summary: The agent provides a functional LightGBM solution with decent date-based feature engineering. However, it introduces critical data leakage by applying frequency encoding to the combined train and test sets before splitting. Furthermore, it fails to respect the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random KFold split, risking look-ahead bias, and entirely skips basic data cleaning.
